Notification:


Changes have been made to this data since the intial publication on 17th September 2026

- The income group has been updated for: Belize, Indonesia, Jordan, Lebanon, Palestine, and Sao Tome for 2024 and 2025

- There have been amendments to projects 'BiMultiBreakdown' with 17 projects across 2023 and 2024 changing from 'Other bilateral' to 'Bi through multi' and 4 projects across 2018 to 2024 changing from 'Bi through multi' to 'Other bilateral' 

- 300566-416 has changed from 'Multilateral' to 'Bi through Multi'

- Changes have been made to some descriptions (ChannelofDelivery, TypeofAidText, SpecificSectorText) to ensure they match the code (ChannelCode, TypeofAidCode, SpecificSectorCode)

We apologise for any inconvenience caused. Please contact statistics@fcdo.gov.uk if you have any questions.  
Our revisions policy can be found at: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/61543348d3bf7f718faab6d2/FCDO-Revisions-Policy.pdf
